note: The towns a Pokémon can live in. Adding a town (Expansion Pass Part 3, 2027) is one more object in `towns`; the app renders whatever is here, in `order`. `aliases` are spellings used by data sources (Serebii says 'Withered Wastelands'). `otherPlaces` are locations the sources mention that are NOT towns and never appear on the board.

towns.name: Bleak Beach
towns.basedOn: Vermilion City and the S.S. Anne, in darkness
towns.unlock: Finish "Yawn Up a Storm!" in the Wasteland

towns.name: Rocky Ridges
towns.basedOn: Pewter City and Mt. Moon, ash-covered

towns.name: Sparkling Skylands
towns.basedOn: Celadon and Saffron as floating sky islands
towns.unlock: Main requests in the first three towns, plus Hyper Trainer rank

towns.name: Palette Town
towns.basedOn: Sandbox islands, no story; 25 exclusive Pokémon incl. all Eeveelutions

towns.name: Bubbly Basin
towns.unlock: Expansion Pass Part 1 (Aug 2026) plus a Bleak Beach request and the Dive move

otherPlaces.name: Cloud Island
otherPlaces.note: Online build space, not a town. Most habitats also work there.

otherPlaces.name: Dream Islands
otherPlaces.note: Resource trips, not a town. Some legendaries are met there.
